properties.why: A tree of the Granary Burying Ground that is in neither the city inventory nor OpenStreetMap (the inventory has no tree under this crown): a dense dark-green crown about 14 m across in the USGS NAIP photograph of 7 July 2023, at 42.35736,-71.06224. The crown is a disc fitted to the canopy of that photograph's vegetation-index picture by circle packing and checked by eye against the photograph in the places with most trees; where crowns touch, the number and positions of the trees are the packing's best reading, not a count of trunks. Species and leaf type cannot be told from above, so none is set; height is left to the pipeline's estimate from the crown width.
